items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: when I first joined the band once... His name was George Frazier... I could see George because he was sitting right in front.

ctx.x: How do you feel -- have you been conscious of critics over the years when they write about you?

Well, I've never been mad with any, I really haven't. I've been -- critics have been pretty nice to me, really. I haven't had -- ever had one to really put me down. I'll tell you, when I first joined the band once, I thought one was going to put me down. His name was George Frazier He used to be up in Boston. I think George has passed and George didn't have a pleasant face anyway, you know? He looked like this all the time, mean, you know. So this night, we just -- I'd been in the band, I guess, maybe two or…
